Population.evidence_source: Participants struggled with this information, as upon their return home decedents almost immediately continued to engage in very concerning and sometimes overt suicidal behaviour. Family members were at a loss how to respond, given that they had been assured of the safety of their loved one.

Area.evidence_source: Our participants found it very difficult engaging with health services. Despite their knowledge of their family member, and the awareness of the risks for suicide, participants were continually reassured that their loved ones were all right and that concerns for their safety were groundless.
